title: Rectangular block
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a closed loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0). The second line extends from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.1429). The third line runs from (0.75, 0.1429) to (0.0, 0.1429), and the fourth line completes the loop by connecting (0.0, 0.1429) back to the origin. Scale this two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.75. Ensure that the scaled sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by setting the Euler angles and translation vector to zero. Extrude the scaled sketch along the normal direction by 0.0143 units to create a three-dimensional solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular block will be approximately 0.75 units in length, 0.1429 units in width, and 0.0143 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.1429).lineTo(0, 0.1429).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0143)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = extrusion

     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Rectangular plate with slightly rounded corners
length = 0.75
width = 0.1429
thickness = 0.0143
corner_radius = 0.005

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(corner_radius, 0)
    .lineTo(length - corner_radius, 0)
    .threePointArc((length, 0), (length, corner_radius))
    .lineTo(length, width - corner_radius)
    .threePointArc((length, width), (length - corner_radius, width))
    .lineTo(corner_radius, width)
    .threePointArc((0, width), (0, width - corner_radius))
    .lineTo(0, corner_radius)
    .threePointArc((0, 0), (corner_radius, 0))
    .close()
    .extrude(thickness)
)
